purpose: Prevent bootstrap/status projections and cross-owner summaries from becoming stale shadow authorities. Semantic owners remain authoritative; projections point to owners, stay fresh, and referenced-owner semantics must not be reimplemented by contradictory copies.

CURRENT_SYSTEM.json.may_contain: release identity, owner references, bounded assurance summaries and observation-cache pointers
CURRENT_SYSTEM.json.must_not_contain: a competing cognition state machine, host enforcement semantics that contradict HOST_PROFILES, per-child current commit/profile/CI snapshots, or business authority copied from child domains

reconciliation_rule: When a semantic owner changes materially, all affected derived projections are updated in the same candidate or CI fails. A green owner change with a stale projection is not a valid promotion.
cross_owner_reference_rule: When one semantic owner delegates a sub-semantic to another canonical owner, it must carry an owner reference and invariant/assurance summary only; it must not freeze a competing algorithm whose behavior can diverge. CI should test material known delegations such as COMMON_CAPABILITIES -> DELIBERATION_POLICY and AUTHORITY_WRITE_POLICY -> PERSISTENT_ASSET_POLICY.
child_observation_rule: Parent child-head/profile/CI observations belong in state/DOMAIN_HEALTH_INDEX.json as a cache. Fresh domain execution rereads current child authority. CURRENT_SYSTEM must not duplicate those volatile observations.
analogy: Controller-style reconciliation: desired semantic authority is owned once; projections are reconciled views, not competing sources of truth.
anti_bloat: Do not solve projection drift by adding another controller or another current-state mirror. Use owner references, compact projections and static/reproducible reconciliation checks in the existing promotion gate.
